narrative_engine.thesis: Price is stretched 2.14σ from the Day VWAP with crowding exhausted; the reversal proof (div) says fade it back down toward the mean. Stop sits beyond ±3σ at 0.005014; T1 at 0.004735 pays 2.49R with the magnet at the 0σ VWAP.

plan.triggerRule: footprint div (sell) fading the upside stretch — enter on the confirmation bar close
plan.invalidation: ±3σ VWAP (0.005014) or 0.4 ATR past the sweep

targets.label: T3 · Day VAL/VAH or opposite cluster

taker buyVolUsd/sellVolUsd = Binance base-asset taker volume converted at the perp last price
funding: venues missing from the OI chart were weighted at the mean OI of matched venues
funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
